summary: End-to-end testing of EWU Shuttle Survey & Demand Analytics. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases passed covering /api/config, survey lookup regex, survey submit (happy path + lead route + duplicate 409), admin login, analytics with month filter, survey toggle test-data flag flip, ban/unban, reset (testing+month_end), CSV export, change-password rotation, and AI forecast (fallback + Claude Sonnet 5). Frontend: landing → survey wizard full happy path (email regex → info → Chashara route → days → trips → monthly plan → fare agree → review → submit → success card) works; non-Chashara route shows inline lead form and 'contact you soon' thank-you; admin login works and dashboard renders KPI cards (4 respondents, ৳4,140 revenue, 0.8% occupancy, peak UP1·4), all charts (day/trip/route), heatmap, responses table; month filter re-fetches analytics (All time=4 → April 2026=3); survey toggle button clickable.

issues: Test-data rows are described as 'pink' but computed backgroundColor scanned did not match common pink shades — verify visually that pink highlight is actually applied to rows where is_test_data=true; may just be a very subtle tint.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 696 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider modularizing into routers (public, admin, analytics, forecast).

compute_price() ignores payload.days when computing weekly cost — it only iterates trips_per_day. If a day has an empty trip list it is silently dropped. Acceptable but ensure UI enforces at least one trip per selected day.
/api/survey/submit fires-and-forgets send_confirmation_email — errors only go to logs; consider queuing failures for retry.
AdminDashboard 'ban-email-input' etc appear to live under a tab that must be selected first — not a bug, but worth documenting.
test_credentials: admin@ewushuttle.com / Admin@123 — rotated and restored during change-password test.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests submit several surveys (unique emails per run) and leave one lead + a couple of surveys in DB after run. Frontend tests added 2 more surveys and 1 lead. State can be cleaned via Admin > Reset (testing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is reusable (auto-cleans state via /admin/reset in a session fixture). Use uniquely-generated emails to avoid 409. Frontend admin Bans/Leads/Actions live under tabs that must be clicked before their inputs (e.g. ban-email-input) become visible. Pricing formula: round-trip if both UP and DOWN chosen for a day, else one-way; total = sum_of_daily × weeks(monthly=4/semester=16).
